name: Gas export / reinforcement centrifugal compressor train
description: Raises gas pressure for export pipeline or reservoir reinjection. Integrally geared and multistage centrifugal machines cover high-volume pipeline/process duty; drivers are electric motors or steam/gas turbines, with dry gas seals and oil systems as auxiliaries.

specifications.basis: Howden/KK&K single-stage centrifugal model range (SF 15,000-600,000; SFG 5,000-300,000; ST 1,500-150,000; SL 15,000-450,000 m3/h), pressure ratio up to 3.5
Howden/KK&K + CKD multistage range (RS 400-65,000; RV 400-85,000 / 400-170,000 back-to-back), pressure ratio up to 10.0
Howden Periflow compressor performance, capacity flow 10-20,000 m3/h, variable speed 1000-6000 rpm
Howden industrial centrifugal turbo compressors, 'proven over 100 years and 4000 installations'

Howden states screw compressors 'selected for a number of FLNG projects for their compact design, high performance and reliability' (FLNGscrewcompressor.pdf listed on page); no numeric rating printed on fetched page
